scripts.build: bun run --filter @kbui/tokens build && bun run --filter @kbui/css build && bun run --filter @kbui/react build
scripts.test: bun run --filter './packages/*' test && bun test scripts
scripts.check: bun run build && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.storybook: bun run build && bun run --filter @kbui/storybook dev
